detail.title: Mechanisms for Autonomous Objective Discovery
detail.question: Can an artificial process formulate, evaluate, and pursue novel, self-generated objectives without explicit human or external instruction?
detail.reason: Maintaining active project alignment with autonomous objective discovery.

children.title: Foundations of Autonomous Objective Discovery in Artificial Systems

detail.title: Foundations of Autonomous Objective Discovery in Artificial Systems
detail.summary: Autonomous agents leverage curiosity-driven learning to navigate complex environments, effectively bootstrapping discovery in the presence of deceptive or sparse rewards. PC-PPO and related multi-objective reinforcement learning (MORL) frameworks allow for non-dominated policy maintenance, yet systems remain limited by underlying convexity assumptions in scalarization functions when attempting to self-formulate new research objectives.
detail.reason: Update notebook to incorporate recent evidence regarding MO-DRL frameworks and MORL challenges.

detail.title: Revised: Mechanisms of Unassigned Objective Discovery
detail.summary: Objective discovery in autonomous systems is mediated by the interplay between learned value systems and active inference processes that regulate cognitive effort, now recognized as requiring collaborative alignment in multi-agent settings.
detail.reason: Updated synthesis incorporating new multi-agent evidence.
